text:
A chaos agent who controls the battlefield through tricks and deception.

Primary: DEX | Secondary: INT

MP mechanic: MP generates passively from INT+DEX+gear - use Mana Burst to release it all as an AoE explosion.

Skills:
Decoy - summon mirror image that pulls aggro
Poison Bomb - AoE poison DoT
Smoke Bomb - 3x3 mobs lose target
Delirium - mob attacks random nearby mobs
Blackout - blind mob, stops attacking
Mana Burst - MP-scaled AoE explosion
Web Trap - place trap, first mob triggers root + slow
Puppeteer - convert mob to fight other mobs for 8 seconds
Vanishing Act - 3-tile teleport + invisible for 3 seconds, drops all aggro
